title: Internal: Opening Business Checking Accounts
summary: This document explains eligibility and steps to open a business checking account: the customer must be verified, have at least one personal checking account with status OPEN, have no CLOSED accounts, not exceed 6 business checking accounts, and have an existing personal checking balance of at least $500. It then outlines the opening procedure: verify identity, confirm eligibility, confirm the desired account_class (e.g., Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue), and open the account using open_bank_account_4821.
